description:
Lightweight, local-first instant replay recorder for Windows 11.

Flashback keeps the last moments of your screen in a rolling replay buffer using your graphics card's hardware encoder, and saves an MP4 the instant you press a shortcut or say "Flashback clip", already filed under the game you were playing.
It needs no account and shows no ads. It includes a trim editor, Discord-sized copies, montages with music, editable game and microphone audio tracks, per-game profiles and a keystroke overlay. Optional Flashback Cloud adds share links that preview in Discord.
